notes: Smarter, shared answer memory across BOTH apply buttons. The 'Mass Apply Jobs' engine already auto-fills from your saved profile and learns answers; it now also answers RE-WORDED but equivalent questions from memory (e.g. 'Notice period' vs 'What's your notice period?') without asking again — while carefully never borrowing an answer from a genuinely different question. The 'Apply All' toolbar now reads the same shared profile + learned memory + fuzzy recall, so both buttons behave the same. Save your Application profile in Options; anything not there is learned the first time you answer it.
